description: Siticone NetFrameworkUI is a modern UI library for .NET Framework 4.8 and above. Build fast, sleek, and high-performance WinForms desktop apps with hardware-accelerated, pixel-perfect controls—seamlessly integrated for a polished, modern experience.
releaseNotes:
Release Notes and Important Information

-- Before You Update:
- This update has breaking changes, please backup all your projects BEFORE updating.

- Always back up your projects BEFORE updating.
- Review changes BEFORE updating.
- Contact us if you have questions BEFORE updating.

## We've enhanced and optimized the performance of many controls in the Library, and have added the 'Ultraperformance Mode' feature which guarantees extremely refine performance. The 'Ultraperformance Mode' can be turned ON/OFF and now provides maximum speed by disabling animations, ripples, and shadows, etc., while specifically preserving the high-quality rendering for the control to ensure the control remains visually sharp.

## When you care about performance more than visual presentation and appeal, you can now Turn on 'Ultraperformance Mode' which prioritizes performance over visual appeal. When turned ON, your UI will feel more fast, performance and very responsive.

## When you care more about a balanced UI presentation with some animations and effect, you can turn OFF 'Ultraperformance Mode' then configure individual control settings to enable and disable individual features and fine-tune the control performance to suit your needs, preferences and taste.


## Enhancements:
1. Ultra-Fast Performance Mode:
Description: A new Boolean property, Ultrafast Performance, has been added. When set to true, it disables computationally expensive visual features for maximum speed, rendering and performance.

2. All controls below have been enhanced and optimized for fast performance, rendering and speed beyond the Ultrafast Performance feature to guarantee smooth and best performance across ultra performance and none ultra performance modes.
